xl.$description: Page-band cap (ADR-041 --bds-content-width-xl). `full` re-points to the content-width-full rung (100%).

lg.$description: Band — feature grids, CTA bands. CSS --bds-content-width-lg.

md.$description: Band — standard text-led body section. CSS --bds-content-width-md.

sm.$description: Band — narrow band, focused forms. CSS --bds-content-width-sm.

text-md.$description: Text column — long-form prose, rich-text body (ADR-041). Same in every mode: a text measure does not widen with the page band. CSS --bds-content-width-text-md.

text-xs.$description: TEXT COLUMN — short intro: eyebrow + one-line title. Caps a text column, never a band. Mode-invariant.

text-sm.$description: TEXT COLUMN — section intro: title + description (the default). Caps a text column, never a band. Mode-invariant.

linear.$description: Constant velocity — marquees, continuous loops. CSS --bds-ease-linear.

marquee.$description: Loop period: one full marquee cycle. Not a tween — tweens use primitives duration/100-600.
